title: Vitex agnus-castus essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Vitex agnus-castus essential oil is derived from the flowering plant Vitex agnus-castus, commonly known as chaste tree or vervain. This essential oil is widely used in herbalism for its potential hormonal balancing properties, particularly in supporting women's health. It is often utilized to address menstrual irregularities, PMS symptoms, and hormonal imbalances. The oil may also be used topically to alleviate skin conditions and reduce inflammation. In traditional medicine, it has been valued for its calming and mood-enhancing effects.
